VBO:0201224.summary: The Shih-Poo combines Shih Tzu and Poodle ancestry, with more than one breeding route behind the name. StonyRidge describes first crosses using Toy Poodles, while a separately documented breeding dog has a Toy Poodle father and a first-cross Shih-Poo mother. These are different generations of the cross, so the label alone does not fix a dog’s proportions, coat or character.
VBO:0201224.shortDescription: A Shih Tzu–Poodle cross found in both first-generation litters and Poodle backcrosses, with individual variation.
